name: Shokushu Injoku ~Gyakukan Tengoku Kairaku Jigoku~
original_name: 触手淫辱～虐姦天国・快楽地獄～
source:
* Game Description: The genius scientist Saburo Kuroiwa has invented the ultimate in sex toys: "Tentacle."
The tentacle escapes and goes on a wild rampage raping the young women it comes across.

* Three different women characters are raped and all are fully voiced so you can hear their cries and screams.
A young aristocratic woman is humiliated as her asshole is expunged and violated. The class president has her holes clogged with semen while in the school gym.
In a gloomy grotto a young girl is impregnated and gives birth!

* Two story lines to follow.
Watch the tentacles aphrodisiac that sends the girls haywire. Or, play the complete rape plot line. 
Two completely different types of play to enjoy! What scene and what story line will you find yourself enjoying?!
